name: CDSHooksServices
title: CDSHooks Discovery Response (Logical Definition)
description: This structure is defined to allow the FHIR Validator to validate a CDSHooks Discovery response body.

element.short: The response to the discovery endpoint
element.definition: The response to the discovery endpoint SHALL be an object containing a list of CDS Services

element.comment: If the CDS server hosts no CDS Services, the discovery endpoint should return a 200 HTTP response with an empty array of services. Note that a CDS server can host multiple entries of CDS service with the same id for different hooks. This allows a service to update its advice based on changes in workflow.

element.short: The hook this service should be invoked on
element.definition: The hook this service should be invoked on

element.short: The human-friendly name of this service
element.definition: The human-friendly name of this service

element.short: The {id} portion of the URL to this service
element.definition: The {id} portion of the URL to this service which is available at {baseUrl}/cds-services/{id}

element.short: Key/value pairs of FHIR queries to provide when calling
element.definition: An object containing key/value pairs of FHIR queries that this service is requesting the CDS Client to perform and provide on each service call. The key is a string that describes the type of data being requested and the value is a string representing the FHIR query
Key of FHIR query - name for client to use when sending prefetched data to the service
A FHIR query for the CDS Client to perform, which may include prefetch tokens

element.short: Human-friendly preconditions for the use of this CDS Service
element.definition: Human-friendly description of any preconditions for the use of this CDS Service
The version of the CDS Hooks specification implemented (STU1 | STU2 | STU3)
